response.answer: Javier Rando is a leading researcher in AI safety at ETH Zurich, focusing on vulnerabilities in AI systems and their applications in high-performance computing. He advocates for responsible AI development and aims to ensure AI benefits humanity safely.

results.title: The researcher making AI safer | ETH Zurich - ETH Zürich
results.content: Javier Rando is undertaking a PhD at ETH Zurich on the safety of artificial intelligence (AI). At the same time, he emphasises that his view of AI is not fundamentally negative: “Artificial intelligence has the potential to become one of the best technologies in human history.” It could simplify our lives, such as by developing cures for diseases and much more. When asked about the difference between researching at universities and at tech companies, he says, “Both approaches are needed to make the AI of the future sufficiently safe and to be able to reap its rewards.” The advantage of being a researcher at a company is that it gives you access to unlimited computing power and you know the company’s AI inside out. Over the next few years, Javier Rando plans to continue researching the safety of AI applications at Anthropic while completing his PhD. Perhaps in a few years’ time, I’ll be replaced by AI at work as well,” says Rando.
